messages:
priya: quick flag - finance got an alert: StratusTech marketplace reports show ~0.8% of usage events unaccounted for in ingest. Need a coordinated partner escalation and a short playbook to avoid over-crediting customers.

maria: thanks. do we know whether these are lost events or late arrivals? any common customer clusters?

alex: initial triage: spikes of 502/timeout from marketplace-proxy around 02:20-02:45 UTC correlated with partner fanout bursts. proxy logs: `[2026-03-22T02:22:11Z] ERROR upstream 502 id=evt_ST_9bx` and a few 504s.

jordan: billing ops ran nightly_recon and labelled most as LOST or LATE_ARRIVAL; small number flagged SKU_MISMATCH. We'll need canonical reason codes so finance can process adjustments consistently.

carla: sales/product want a customer messaging template that avoids automatic credits when partner delivery is at fault. also want a clear owner field in the recon report (partner_vs_internal).

dmitri: partners often retry without jitter. recommend publishing a partner retry guideline: exponential backoff + jitter, max_retries=5, retry-after header honored. I'll draft this and share.

priya: actionable items proposal: 1) immediate partner ask: provide S3 ack logs for last 14 days with event_id + http_status, 2) short-term infra: add x-rw-event-id header enforcement and x-rw-sig HMAC for verification, 3) billing: adopt canonical reason codes [LOST, DUP, LATE_ARRIVAL, SKU_MISMATCH, OUT_OF_WINDOW], 4) reconciliation: nightly_recon to accept partner_acks and output CSV with event_id, customer_id, partner_ack_ts, ingest_ts, delta_seconds, reason_code, owner.

alex: infra notes: we'll add distributed tracing spans at fanout and ingest joined by event_id. also add idempotency dedupe at fanout (x-rw-idempotency-key). ETA: spans + dedupe in 6 days, header enforcement in 3 days.

maria: SKU mapping issue - StratusTech sends sku_code that we don't map for a handful of customers; leads to false SKU_MISMATCH. Need a SKU mapping table and validation hook to surface bad SKUs back to partner immediately.

jordan: on reconciliation rules, propose acceptance windows: <=72h auto-accept; 72h-7d require partner proof (ack logs); >7d auto-reject unless approved by finance. Also surface USD impact per candidate so we triage by dollars.

carla: I'll draft the customer-facing message templates and an internal playbook for when to credit vs when to require partner remediation.

billing-bot: automated-report: nightly_recon job completed. total_events=1,120,934; flagged=9,007; top_issues=[LOST:6,800, LATE_ARRIVAL:1,900, SKU_MISMATCH:307]. recon_report: https://redwood.prod/recon/1991200000

priya: thanks @billing-bot. Maria/Dmitri please pick up StratusTech escalation. Alex/Jordan will you coordinate the recon CSV schema so finance can consume it?

maria: taking the StratusTech escalation. will collect sample event payloads + traces and open the partner ticket.

dmitri: will send the retry & header spec to StratusTech + a template for ack logs.

alex: Jordan - I'll drop a CSV schema in #partnerships in 2hrs and include the acceptance window logic.

jordan: copy. I'll wire the nightly_recon export to S3 path /recon/partner_exports/1991200000.csv for finance access. ETA: 48hrs for MVP.

priya: great. regroup tomorrow after partner ack logs arrive. thank you all :thumbsup:
